We’ll guide you step by step as you design either a fresh bouquet in a vase or a table centerpiece, using seasonal flowers and greenery. services.desc: Join our beginner-friendly kids-teens extended 90-minutes art classes this fall semester 2026 at a real art studio in Naples. These small group classes (4-6-10 children) are designed to help kids explore creativity, color, and confidence through abstract painting in a calm, inspiring environment. Each 90-minutes class is $40 per child and is usually held on Mondays and Saturdays at my Shirley Street studio. Monthly payment is $160 per student, and we’re happy to offer flexible rescheduling if your plans change.
